comment: The browser the assistant drives, and the automation JavaScript that runs inside it. ONE file, because they are ONE decision: Playwright's injected script is written against the Chromium it ships with, and bumping either alone is a drift nothing would report. Every half that cares reads this file and a test asserts it, the way desktop/link-tools.json is read by both halves of the link.
archives_comment: One entry per platform we publish, read by desktop/shared/src/browser/binary.rs. The digest is pinned HERE, inside the signed application, and deliberately NOT taken from the .sha256 published beside the download: a hash fetched from the same place as the bytes proves only that the two agree, so a repository that had been tampered with would serve a different browser and a matching hash for it. These were computed from the bytes actually mirrored, by the machine that mirrored them. A platform with no entry is one nothing has been published for, and the install says so by name rather than fetching something unverified.
licence_comment: Chromium is BSD-3-Clause, which asks that a binary redistribution reproduce its notice in the materials shipped with it. The notice that build ships is copied verbatim to orchestrator/internal/licences/chrome-headless-shell.txt and published on the console's open source screen. It belongs to the version above: changing the pin without recopying the notice publishes the notices of a build nobody is running.
